title: LightningExitByPageMetrics - Data API
description: Represents frequency metrics about the standard pages within which users switched from Lightning Experience to Salesforce Classic. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

MetricsDate.description: The date that the data was recorded.

PageName.description: The name of the page from which the user switched from Lightning Experience to Salesforce Classic.

RecordCount.description: The number of records per user and page.

UserId.description: UserId of the user who views page. This is a relationship field.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="LightningExitByPageMetrics">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="MetricsDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:date"/>
        <element name="PageName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="RecordCount" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
        <element name="SystemModstamp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="User" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="UserId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```

Id.field_label: Lightning Exit By Page Metrics ID
